title: Author Dual Wiki Corpus, Link and 400-Line Limit Tests
instructions: Create the file: this chunk owns the module docstring, imports and constants. Write physical pytest cases (real SQLite FTS5 databases and Markdown files under tmp_path; no mock objects): test_ch06_fr_001_* for SRS-412-06-FR-001 (The system shall maintain permanent reference knowledge in `.sources/` and live ratified specifications in `wiki/`.); test_ch06_fr_007_* for SRS-412-06-FR-007 (Scientific notation, quantum formulas, and Greek characters (`Ψ(r)`, `ΔG°`, `kJ·mol⁻¹`) shall be preserved losslessly in UTF-8.); test_ch06_fr_004_* for SRS-412-06-FR-004 (All relative Markdown links across wiki chapters shall be programmatically validated with 0 broken cross-references.); test_ch06_fr_005_* for SRS-412-06-FR-005 (Every SRS and wiki chapter document shall strictly enforce a maximum length limit of <= 400 lines.); test_ch06_fr_006_* for SRS-412-06-FR-006 (The knowledge base structure and document catalog shall be synchronized with `v4.1.2_manifest.json`.). Section 9 obligations: Test asserts `00_skeleton.md` indexes all chapters. Test verifies all generated chapters are strictly <= 400 lines. Test asserts relative links in markdown chapters resolve to physically existing files.
